fields.label: Labor Markup %
fields.description: Markup applied to labor + labor burden (client-side price build; excluded from Acumatica budget).

fields.label: Material Markup %
fields.description: Markup applied to material cost (client-side; excluded from Acumatica budget).

fields.label: Other Markup %
fields.description: Markup applied to roll-off/misc other costs (client-side; excluded from Acumatica budget).

fields.label: Commission Markup %
fields.description: Markup applied to commission + commission burden (client-side; excluded from Acumatica budget).

fields.label: Burden Rate %
fields.description: Burden rate applied to labor, commissions, and geo commission (hardcoded 20% on the sheet; exposed as an input).

fields.label: Commission Rate %
fields.description: Sales commission rate applied to the marked-up cost subtotal. Tier guide (sheet legend): job margin >=30% -> 2.5%; 25-30% -> 2%; 20-25% -> 1.5%; <20% -> none. See quirks: legend says rate applies to Total Contract Price, formula applies it to the cost subtotal.

fields.label: Geo Commission (Flat)
fields.description: Flat geo commission dollars.

fields.label: Job City
fields.description: City of the job - drives the retail city tax rate (rate table in the City Tax Rates tab / portal config).

fields.label: City Tax Rate %
fields.description: Combined retail tax rate for the job city (e.g. 9.3). Auto-filled by the portal from the city tax table; editable.

fields.label: Warranty Line Item Amount
fields.description: Additional warranty line item charged to the client (added to the proposal total; NOT part of the Acumatica cost budget).

fields.label: Warranty Cost
fields.description: Internal cost of the additional warranty (additional 5 years / 10 total).

fields.label: Contract Presented Amount
fields.description: Total of contract actually presented to the client (typically the proposal cost, rounded).

fields.label: Shingle Labor Total
fields.description: Labor_Rate_Shingle__c x Squares_Shingle__c

fields.label: Tile Labor Total
fields.description: Labor_Rate_Tile__c x Squares_Tile__c

fields.label: Modified Labor Total
fields.description: Labor_Rate_Modified__c x Squares_Modified__c

fields.label: Recoat Labor Total
fields.description: Labor_Rate_Recoat__c x Squares_Recoat__c

fields.label: Total Labor Budget
fields.description: Acumatica: Labor line (task code TBD). Sum of the four roof-type labor totals

fields.label: Labor Burden Budget
fields.description: Acumatica: Burden line (task code TBD). Total_Labor_Budget__c x Burden_Rate__c

fields.label: Labor Markup Amount
fields.description: (Labor + Burden) x Labor_Markup_Percent__c - client-side only

fields.label: Labor Total With Markup
fields.description: Labor + Burden + Labor Markup

fields.label: Total Material Budget
fields.description: Acumatica: Material line (task code TBD). Sum of all 46 material line items (qty x cost)

fields.label: Material Markup Amount
fields.description: Total_Material_Budget__c x Material_Markup_Percent__c

fields.label: Material Total With Markup
fields.description: Material + Material Markup. Also the taxable amount.

fields.label: Roll-Off Total
fields.description: Roll_Off_Qty__c x Roll_Off_Cost__c

fields.label: Misc Other Total
fields.description: Misc_Other_Qty__c x Misc_Other_Cost__c

fields.label: Other Budget
fields.description: Acumatica: Other line (task code TBD). Roll-off + misc other

fields.label: Other Markup Amount
fields.description: Other_Budget__c x Other_Markup_Percent__c

fields.label: Other Total With Markup
fields.description: Other + Other Markup

fields.label: Cost Subtotal (Marked Up)
fields.description: Labor w/ markup + Material w/ markup + Other w/ markup

fields.label: Commission Amount
fields.description: Acumatica: Commission line (task code TBD). Cost_Subtotal__c x Commission_Rate_Percent__c

fields.label: Commission Burden Amount
fields.description: Acumatica: Commission burden (task code TBD). Commission_Amt__c x Burden_Rate__c

fields.label: Commission Markup Amount
fields.description: (Commission + Burden) x Commission_Markup_Percent__c - client-side only

fields.label: Geo Burden Amount
fields.description: Acumatica: Geo burden (task code TBD). Geo_Commission_Amount__c x Burden_Rate__c

fields.label: Commission Total
fields.description: Commission + burden + markup + geo + geo burden

fields.label: Total Job Cost (Client)
fields.description: All-in client-side cost: marked-up labor + materials + other + commissions

fields.label: Acumatica Budget Total
fields.description: Acumatica: Sum of Acumatica lines. True cost (no markups): labor + burden + material + other + commissions + geo w/ burdens

fields.label: Markup Profit Dollars
fields.description: Total_Job_Cost_Client__c - Acumatica_Budget_Total__c

fields.label: City Tax Amount
fields.description: City_Tax_Rate__c x Taxable_Amount__c

fields.label: Warranty Delta
fields.description: Warranty_Line_Item_Amount__c - Warranty_Cost__c (negative = warranty cost not passed on)

fields.label: Total Proposal Cost
fields.description: Total_Job_Cost_Client__c + City_Tax_Amount__c + Warranty_Line_Item_Amount__c

fields.label: Proposal Cost Less Taxes
fields.description: Total_Proposal_Cost__c - City_Tax_Amount__c

fields.label: Total Squares
fields.description: Shingle + Tile + Modified + Recoat squares

fields.label: Budgeted Hours
fields.description: Total_Labor_Budget__c / 29 (sheet constant $29/hr - see quirks)

fields.label: Days On Job (4-Man Crew)
fields.description: Budgeted_Hours__c / 32 (4 men x 8 hours)

fields.label: Profit After Commission %
fields.description: Markup_Profit_Dollars__c / Total_Job_Cost_Client__c

fields.label: Cost Per Square (All-In)
fields.description: Total_Proposal_Cost__c / Total_Squares__c (sheet divides by TILE squares only - see quirks)

fields.label: Cost Per Square (No Tax)
fields.description: Proposal_Cost_Less_Taxes__c / Total_Squares__c

fields.label: Budget Last Calculated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful budget calculation.

fields.label: Budget Calc Status
fields.description: Pending (recalc requested) -> Calculated / Error, managed by the trigger Flow and budget Lambda.

fields.label: Budget Calc Error
fields.description: Last calculation error message; cleared on success.

fields.label: Budget Finalized
fields.description: When checked, the budget is pushed to Acumatica ProjectBudget lines.

fields.label: Latest Budget File Path
fields.description: S3 key of the most recent budget workbook snapshot (SUNDIAL/{record_id}/...).

fields.label: Dealer
fields.description: The dealer that owns this project. Not used for access today - the Roofing module is closed to sales roles.

fields.label: Created Date
fields.description: When the record was created (the original system's created date where one was migrated).

fields.label: Record ID
fields.description: The Salesforce record id (join key).
